manifest.name: Production Direct X/Y/Z Normalized LUT v1

fixtures.operator_note: Confirm the production image is flashed, both limit switches are released, and the direct X/Y/Z envelope is clear. Firmware homes Z and XY, makes one 14,000-logical-unit move on each axis and one 2,000-unit triangular X move at 40 kHz logical rate, then homes again. Stop for contact, abnormal sound, missing motion/home, reset, or watchdog evidence.
